name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Lakeland FL

fieldNotes.step0: Resolved the exact Sam's Club / Walmart DC operating block inside the multi-tenant Saddle Creek Logistics campus on Saddle Creek Rd, Lakeland. Confirmed by Street View trailers carrying the Walmart 'spark' logo and Saddle Creek 3PL trailers along the internal road fence; SupplierWiki lists this as Sam's Club DC 8229 c/o Saddle Creek Corp (Bldg 19).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Hip/pyramid-roofed booth sitting in the median island between the inbound and outbound truck lanes at ~28.0772,-81.8966 (z20 satellite), confirmed from ground level as a low canopied gatehouse with lane markings and perimeter fencing.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled checkpoint: median guard booth, fenced drive, lane markings; trucks queue on both approaches. Gate sits deep inside the campus off the signalized internal Saddle Creek Rd intersection.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron with room to add an express/bypass lane around the single booth.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Main DC building has dock banks on both its west and east faces, plus a separate N-S cross-dock finger building with doors on both sides — distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~140 is an overhead estimate across the main building's two faces plus the cross-dock finger; flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~320 trailers counted across drop rows and dock positions; capacity ~420. Approximate from z18-z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lakeland eastern edge among retention ponds, fields and low-density residential; large industrial campus on a rural arterial — Rural per the small-town-vs-urban tiebreak.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sam's Club block is one operating unit within a much larger multi-building 3PL campus; multiple large building clusters on the same property.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the west edge of the campus but no spur enters this DC's yard/docks; set false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in the gate path; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: Booth flanked by one lane each side at the checkpoint; lane count is a best estimate.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Single checkpoint observed; no clear second booth/scale stage before the docks.

citations.claim: Official Sam's Club DC receiving-address list includes 'Sams Distribution Center 8229, 3010 Saddlecreek Rd Bld 19, C/O Saddle Creek Corp, Lakeland, FL 33801'.
Saddle Creek Logistics named Sam's Club 3PL Service Provider of the Year; operates the Lakeland DC.

verification.rationale: Confirmed Sam's Club DC 8229 operated by 3PL Saddle Creek Logistics at 3010 Saddle Creek Rd, Lakeland; no closure. Operator=Saddle Creek (do not confuse with the Lakeland retail club).
